summary: A small computer program, rather than tests on people, calculated a low risk score for heart harm and a low risk score for liver harm [M]. Although this drug does not list its own problems, similar medicines carry strong boxed warnings in the United States for heart harm, blood vessel issues, nerve and brain harm, and immune system problems [3][4][5]. Several research studies on the drug were stopped early because researchers had trouble finding enough patients to take part or faced disruptions from the COVID-19 pandemic [7][8][9].
